faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a_what: MochiFast is a friendly intermittent fasting coach that helps you build sustainable fasting habits with plans, reminders, and gentle progress tracking.
faq.q_start: How do I start a fasting?
faq.a_start: Pick a fasting plan that fits your lifestyle, set your meal window, then tap start when you're ready. We'll guide you through each phase.
faq.a_beginner: Yes. We recommend gentler schedules like 12:12 or 14:10 first, then you can step up when it feels comfortable.
faq.q_premium: What's included in Free vs Premium?
faq.a_premium: Free covers core fasting timers and basic tracking. Premium unlocks AI chat, all fasting plans, deeper insights, and extra coaching tools.
faq.a_history: Yes. Open Fasting History from your profile to review past sessions, streaks, and how your consistency has grown.
faq.q_cancel: How do I cancel a subscription?
faq.a_cancel: Manage or cancel Premium anytime in your App Store or Google Play subscriptions. Access stays active until the current period ends.

chat.greeting: How can I help you today?
chat.suggestion_hungry: I feel so hungry, should I break my fast?
chat.suggestion_coffee: Can I drink coffee while fasting?
chat.suggestion_weight: Why am I not losing weight yet?
chat.suggestion_eat: What should I eat when my fast ends?
chat.reply_hungry_1: That hunger dip is so normal, squish. It usually passes in ~20 min. Try a big glass of water or black coffee first?
chat.reply_hungry_2: You've got this — and breaking early is okay too, no guilt. 💛
chat.reply_coffee: Yes — black coffee is fine while fasting. Skip cream, milk, and sweetener so you stay in your fast.
chat.reply_weight: Weight can stall even when fat loss is happening. Stay consistent a few more days and watch how your clothes feel too.
chat.reply_eat: Break gently: protein + fiber first — eggs, yogurt, or a veggie bowl. Save the heavy stuff for later.
chat.reply_default: Got it, squish. Tell me a bit more and I'll coach you through it. 💪
chat.empty_subtitle: Start a conversation with Coach Mochi and your chats will show up here.
